title: HeartBEiT
paper_title: A Foundational Vision Transformer Improves Diagnostic Performance for Electrocardiograms
core_mech: 将标准版式 ECG 渲染为图像，以 BEiT 式离散 masked-patch prediction 预训练专用 ViT。
core_mech_en: Renders standard 12-lead ECG waveforms as 2D layout images and pretrains a Vision Transformer via BEiT-style discrete masked patch token prediction on 8.5 million ECGs.
input_desc: 按标准版式渲染的 12 导联 ECG 图像
input_en: Standardized 2D image rendering of a 12-lead clinical electrocardiogram
output_desc: ECG 诊断分类概率或迁移表征
output_en: Pretrained ECG ViT representation for low-label arrhythmia, LVEF, and STEMI classification

source.title: HeartBEiT
notes: The 2023 paper's Code availability section links this author repository for model creation. Code availability does not establish availability of pretrained weights.
GitHub supplied no detected license and no root LICENSE/COPYING notice was found at this commit. Per-file permissions were not exhaustively audited; no permission to copy is inferred.

adapter.name: HeartBEiT (downstream image architecture)
adapter.mechanism: The author's MIT-attributed BEiT classification encoder receives rasterized synthetic traces; relative position bias, layer scale and mean token pooling are retained.
limitations: Architecture-only exercise: HeartBEiT's DALL-E tokenization, ECG masked pretraining, pretrained weights and cardiac downstream studies are not reproduced.
The default uses four dimensionless synthetic waveform traces rendered on a 64x64 grid; these are not physiological ECGs or calibrated paper ECG images.
Width/depth/patch size are reduced; random weights carry no foundation-model capability.
Only modeling_finetune.py has been copied under its explicit file-level Microsoft MIT notice; the repository's remaining files have no inferred redistribution permission.
